description: Search CruiseMapper.com for cruises matching your filters. All filters are optional; combine any subset.

cruiseType.description: Cruise theme / category (e.g. transatlantic, christmas, food-wine).
cruiseType.title: Cruise type

departureFrom.description: Earliest cruise departure date (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Cruises before this date are dropped. Optional.
departureFrom.title: Earliest departure date

destination.description: Cruise destination region (matches CruiseMapper's port-region taxonomy).
destination.title: Destination region

endDate.description: Latest cruise departure date (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Cruises after this date are dropped (filtered after fetch). Optional.
endDate.title: Latest departure date (client-side filter)

enrichWithShipData.description: When true, fetch the ship-detail page for each unique ship and add a `shipDetails` block (year built, builder, gross tonnage, passenger capacity, length, decks, cabins, etc.). Adds ~1 extra HTTP request per unique ship.
enrichWithShipData.title: Enrich with ship-detail data

maxPrice.description: Drop cruises whose starting price exceeds this amount (USD). Default = 10000.
maxPrice.title: Max starting price (USD)

maxResults.description: Hard cap on cruises emitted across all pages.
maxResults.title: Max results

minPrice.description: Drop cruises whose starting price is below this amount (USD). Unpriced sailings are dropped when this is above 0. Default = 0.
minPrice.title: Min starting price (USD)

shipName.description: Filter by ship name (substring match, e.g. `Symphony of the Seas`).
shipName.title: Ship name

startUrls.description: Paste full CruiseMapper search URLs (e.g. `https://www.cruisemapper.com/cruise-search?finder=cruise&portRegion=22&duration=3`). Each URL's query params become a search; results are merged and deduped with the main filter inputs.
startUrls.title: Start URLs (optional)

title: CruiseMapper Cruises Scraper Input
